responsibility: Implements the x86 GFNI intrinsic header for Galois-field byte operations. It conditionally enables the required combinations of gfni with SSE2, AVX, AVX512VL, AVX512BW, and AVX512F, and exposes the packed multiply and affine/affine-inverse transformation intrinsics across 128-bit, 256-bit, and 512-bit vectors with masked variants where applicable, mapping the public API to GCC’s GFNI builtins.
